about: Worked examples for the generator prompt, each taken from a fixed surface that already ships and rewritten so its data is a pointer instead of a pasted literal. `source` names where the layout came from. They double as the fixed-template baseline in the eval: the same layout, resolved against the same data.

exemplars.name: overdue
lines: c wm Metric label="Past due" value=@/q/overdue/count thresholds=[{"at":1,"tone":"bad"}]
c we Events caption="Still marked todo" items=@/q/overdue/events

exemplars.name: due-soon
exemplars.request: anything due in the next two days
lines: c s Screen title="DUE IN TWO DAYS"
c de Events caption="Coming up" items=@/q/due:2/events

exemplars.name: week
exemplars.request: what does my week look like
lines: c row Stack direction=grid cols=2 gap=3
c m1 Metric label="Overdue" value=@/q/overdue/count thresholds=[{"at":1,"tone":"bad"}]
c m2 Metric label="Due this week" value=@/q/due:7/count
c ev Events caption="Classes and deadlines" items=@/q/week:7/events
